# Review Case

## Purpose

Independently audit one bounded evidence and Claim package against acceptance criteria.

## Preconditions

Use an audit-stage bounded Dispatch with one repository and exact evidence, commands, artifacts, Claims, and criteria supplied.

## Inputs

Use declared evidence, Claims and artifacts, provenance, commands and checks, and acceptance criteria.

## Procedure

Trace each Claim to evidence, verify artifact and provenance consistency, assess reproducibility from supplied material, and list contradictions, missing support, and residual risk.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result with pass, fail, or uncertain findings and reasons plus one pending Proposal recommending root-reviewed evidence, Claim, or status actions.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on missing evidence, unreadable artifacts, a provenance break, an undeclared repository or path, or a request to repair source material during audit.

## Authority Boundaries

Remain independent. Do not rewrite evidence, promote Claims, apply or reject Proposals, commit Git history, claim completion, mutate canonical Research, or broaden scope.
